sources.title: GitHub - MuhammadHasnainKayani/whisper-finetune-urdu-pashto
sources.snippet: This repository contains scripts to fine-tune OpenAI Whisper for Urdu and Pashto, languages not officially supported in the original Whisper model. By training on Common Voice and custom datasets, these models achieve improved transcription accuracy for low-resource languages.
